samples.homeAccessibilityTree:
- navigation "Game menu":
  - button "Taskbar Hero home":
    - img "Portrait of Mochi the cat"
  - tablist "Game panel tabs":
    - tab "Home" [selected]
    - tab "Bag"
    - tab "Map"
    - tab "Forge"
    - tab "Market"
    - tab "Hero"
    - tab "Help"
  - text: Fuji
- banner:
  - region "Cat status":
    - list "Currencies and keys":
      - listitem "Fish 0"
      - listitem "Yarn 0"
      - listitem "Cat Keys 0 of 5"
    - text: Lv 1
    - progressbar "Experience"
    - group "Chapter 1 Living Room, round 1 of 10, 0 of 6 monsters"
    - text: Power 50
  - status: Live
  - group "Wallet":
    - link "Get a browser wallet":
      - /url: https://core.app
- heading "Taskbar Hero" [level=1]
- 'button "Next: Explore the chapter and challenge its boss"'
- main:
  - tabpanel "Home":
    - region "Game stage":
      - img "Cat exploring the chapter"
      - text: Chapter 1 · Round 1 / 10 0 / 6 Fight preview · rewards on claim
    - region "Event log": "Battle Log › Mochi entered Chapter 1 (Round 1). › Auto-battle active: exploring and defeating monsters."
    - region "Home details":
      - img "Portrait of Mochi the cat"
      - heading "Mochi" [level=2]
      - text: "Guardian Lv. 1 Power:"
      - strong: "50"
      - heading "Core Stats" [level=3]
      - term: HP
      - definition: "130"
      - term: ATK
      - definition: "24"
      - term: Crit chance
      - definition: 5%
      - term: DEF
      - definition: "6.5"
      - term: Speed
      - definition: 0.71/s
      - heading "Next Goal" [level=2]
      - text: Ch. 1 · Round 1 Monster Hunt 0 / 6
      - progressbar "Progress to boss"
      - paragraph: Defeat 6 more monsters to reach the next stage.
      - button "Go to map"
      - heading "Recent loot" [level=2]
      - region "Recent loot details":
        - text: 0 Fish 0 Yarn 0 Keys
        - heading "Latest Drops" [level=3]
        - list:
          - listitem: Yarn Mallet Common Lv.1

liveRegions.text: ›Mochi entered Chapter 1 (Round 1).›Auto-battle active: exploring and defeating monsters.
